svg.text: DC’s last gambling forecast delivered 13.5 cents on the dollar
Projected vs. actual gambling revenue to the District, millions of dollars
GambetDC actuals are net transfers to the District reported by the DC Office of Lottery and Gaming. In FY2021 GambetDC made no net transfer and lost $4M. Projections are as
reported at the time. The online casino figure is the DC Chief Financial Officer’s projected net impact on District resources in fiscal 2030, from its fiscal impact statement on the
committee print. Lawmakers have cited $73M in tax over four years, and another analysis cited at markup put it near $50M a year.
GambetDC was a lottery-run monopoly. B26-0656 licenses competing national operators, so it may come closer to its estimate, which would mean residents lose more. This compares
DC's track record; it is not a forecast.
Sources: Casino.org, citing DCist (Mar. 2022); DC Office of Lottery and Gaming, FY21-22 oversight presentation; DCist (Mar. 3, 2022); DC Office of Lottery and Gaming, FY22-23
oversight slides; DC Chief Financial Officer, fiscal impact statement on B26-0656 committee print (Nov. 18, 2026); Axios DC (Nov. 18, 2026); Covers (Nov. 18, 2026).
